rewrites.original: — even if they don't use the word "angle" explicitly
rewrites.reason: The agentskills.io specification limits description to 1024 characters; the original was 1026. Only this trailing clause was removed; the trigger list is unchanged.
agentic-os interpolated the request argument; the skill takes it from the invocation.

rewrites.original: Execute this Agentic OS workflow using the selected provider. Vault root: ${root}.
rewrites.replacement: Execute this content-os workflow using the selected provider. Vault root: the content-os vault (see Terms above).
rewrites.reason: agentic-os interpolated its vault path into the prompt; content-os resolves the vault from --vault / CONTENT_OS_VAULT (defined in the adapter section).

rewrites.replacement: Arguments (request data): the topic, seed, angle or URL the user gave when invoking this skill.
rewrites.reason: agentic-os serialized the job arguments into the prompt; a skill receives them from the user's invocation message.

rewrites.original: OUTPUT CONTRACT: The bridge owns the final report at ${destinationFor(job)}.
rewrites.replacement: OUTPUT CONTRACT: This skill saves the final report itself with `scripts/reports.mjs save --skill angle-brainstorm` (step "Save" above), under the vault at `inbox/reports/angles/YYYY-MM-DD-angles-<seed-slug>-<id>.md`.
rewrites.reason: agentic-os has a bridge that saves the returned report. content-os has no bridge: the skill saves the report itself with the bundled reports.mjs (same vault-relative path rules as agentic-os) and still returns the complete Markdown.

rewrites.original: Do not write that destination yourself or substitute
rewrites.replacement: Do not write that destination any other way, or substitute
rewrites.reason: In content-os the skill writes the destination, but only through reports.mjs save, which never overwrites an existing report.
